corroboration_boundary: cbor2 corroborates item encodings only. It does NOT corroborate map key order: its canonical mode implements the length-first ordering of RFC 8949 Section 4.2.3 and not the bytewise ordering of Section 4.2.1 that this document requires. Two numbers produced by one construction are one measurement, and two implementations that disagree are not a vote -- the RFC decides it. Standing rule 8.

defective_encoders.channel: map keys sorted by encoded length then bytewise, RFC 8949 Section 4.2.3 instead of Section 4.2.1

measured_divergence.finding: cbor2 6.1.4 in canonical mode emits the Section 4.2.3 ordering. An implementation that computes ARP digests with it ships non-conforming bytes and raises no error, because both orderings are well-formed CBOR and only one is the one this document cites.
